build_tacotron2_model: build a Tacotron2 text-to-speech model with encoder, decoder, postnet, and optional latent audio encoder
run_tacotron2_inference: run inference on text inputs to generate mel spectrograms using the Tacotron2 model
review_attention_layer: review the Attention class with location-aware alignment energies for decoder attention weights
test_decoder_forward: test the Decoder forward pass with teacher forcing using mel spectrogram inputs
summarize_audioencoder_vae: summarize the AudioEncoder VAE module that encodes mel spectrograms into latent distributions
